analysis:
## Technical analysis

### Session overview — triple catalyst, largest Gate 3 gain

NVDA closed $220.87 on 2026-08-05, up +$9.12 / +4.31% from August 4's $211.75. This is the largest single-session gain of the Gate 3 period (Day 1: +3.46%, Day 2: +3.01%, Day 3: +2.58%, Day 4: +4.31% re-acceleration). Session range: approximately $212.10 (low, near gap-up open) to $222.12 (intraday peak at ~1:41pm ET, +4.9%). Three simultaneous catalysts drove the session: SpaceX exclusive 'Starmind' Vera Rubin partnership; AMD Q2 beat ('AI data center more than doubled YoY'); soft ADP (44K private jobs, Fed hike threat removed).

### Gate 3 four-session scorecard

| Condition | Threshold | Day 1 (Jul 31) | Day 2 (Aug 3) | Day 3 (Aug 4) | Day 4 (Aug 5) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| NVDA price | >$200 | $200.39 (+$0.39) | $206.42 (+$6.42) | $211.75 (+$11.75) | $220.87 (+$20.87) |
| SPX | >7,460 | 7,505.66 (+45.66) | 7,600.50 (+140.50) | 7,737 (+277) | ~7,850+ (est. ~390+) |
| VIX | <17 | 16.21 (0.79 buf) | 15.79 (1.21 buf) | 16.40 (0.60 buf) | 16.50 (0.50 buf) |

NVDA price buffer: consistent expansion every session ($0.39 → $6.42 → $11.75 → $20.87 — accelerating). VIX buffer: declining trend despite positive catalysts — the sole structural concern of the Gate 3 period.

### Trend — four-session staircase; each day clearing one resistance level

The Gate 3 recovery has taken the form of a resistance-ladder ascent: Day 1 cleared $200, Day 2 confirmed higher close, Day 3 broke $210, Day 4 broke $220. From $200.39 to $220.87 is +10.2% in four sessions. The staircase structure (each day's low stays above the prior day's pivot) is technically ideal: $200.39 → $206.42 → $211.75 → $220.87.

### Momentum — estimated RSI 68-72; overbought entering but not extreme

Estimated RSI: ~68-72 (entering overbought from ~63-65 on Day 3). The +4.31% single-session gain drove the elevation. At RSI 68-72, the momentum is strong but not at the extreme levels (>80) that historically precede sharp reversals. Cryptonomist flagged the 'overbought' signal. The RSI elevation is catalyst-driven (SpaceX + AMD), not pure momentum — which means it is justified by fundamentals, though a 1-3 session consolidation at $216-$218 is the likely technical release valve.

### Volume — above average; triple-catalyst institutional conviction

Estimated ~175M shares vs. 90-day average of ~132M = approximately 133% of average. Above-average volume on a catalyst-driven session is the strongest institutional confirmation signal of the Gate 3 period. For comparison, the Day 3 $210 breakout came in at 97.8% of average (a volume concern raised in Day 3's dossier). Today's above-average volume retroactively validates Day 3's $210 breakout: the subsequent institutional buying confirms that the $210 clearance was accepted, not a false signal. Volume is confirming the uptrend.

### ★ Strongest support — $210 (former resistance fully converted to support)

Evidence for ★ designation:
1. FX Leaders 'key level' designation — the market explicitly knows and watches this level; the Day 3 close at $211.75 created institutional memory
2. Day 4 never revisited $210 — the gap-up from $211.75 to $220.87 means Day 4's low ($212.10) stayed $2.10 above the prior resistance; no retest = strong buyer absorption
3. Options OI pivot: $210 call holders who are now long delta above $210 will add mechanically on any dip toward the level
4. SpaceX and AMD buyers who entered today at $212-$218 will use $210 as their stop-loss level, creating structural buy-on-dip demand
5. $10.87 distance from today's close is sufficient buffer to absorb a $216-$218 RSI consolidation without testing $210

### ★ Strongest resistance — $235.47 (52-week high / August 26 earnings target)

All prior evidence remains valid. Added from today's session: AMD's 'more than doubled' AI data center growth rate validates the revenue model that puts NVDA at $235-$250 on a Q2 earnings beat; SpaceX adds a new demand vertical not in analyst models at the time their $302 consensus targets were set; the $302 analyst consensus now has three new catalysts (SSI, SpaceX, AMD sector confirmation) supporting it that were not in the models — meaning $302 may underestimate fair value.

### Pattern — accelerating recovery; resistance ladder being climbed at increasing velocity

Gate 3 cumulative price buffer: $0.39 (Day 1) → $6.42 (Day 2) → $11.75 (Day 3) → $20.87 (Day 4). The acceleration in cumulative buffer ($0.39 to $20.87 in four days) suggests the re-rating trade is gaining momentum. Each new catalyst has compressed the discount-to-fair-value faster.

### Decision points for the near term

**1. NFP Friday (August 7, 8:30am ET)** — Gate 3 condition-3 risk: VIX at 16.50 with 0.50 pts before breach. Soft NFP (<100K, continuing ADP's trend) → VIX eases → Gate 3 fully safe through earnings → $224 next. Hot NFP (>150K) → VIX could open above 17 on Friday → Gate 3 step-aside re-activated at any NVDA price level.

**2. RSI consolidation zone $216-$218** — the likely technical release valve for the overbought condition; a hold above $216 keeps the staircase intact; a close below $212 is the first warning sign.

**3. $224 close** — the next major technical milestone; a close above $224 opens the $235.47 earnings target for the final 18 days of the pre-earnings window.

### What invalidates the bull read

A close below $200 re-activates Gate 3 step-aside immediately. VIX above 17 on any single session re-activates condition-3 breach independent of price. The $220.87 close is $20.87 above the Gate 3 threshold — the widest buffer since re-entry. The sole path to bearish invalidation before August 26 is a hot NFP spike (VIX above 17) or a catastrophic fundamental development (AI demand reversal — which AMD's 'more than doubled' data today makes the least likely in the Gate 3 period).
